480	He has a résumé, thank God: his first murder at fifteen.	Ele tem currículo, graças a HaShem: o primeiro assassinato aos quinze anos.

491	Yitzchak asked for suffering, he said, Master of the World,	Yitzchak pediu sofrimentos, disse: Senhor do Mundo,

493	In the test, he went through fifty-seven years of blindness, Yitzchak Avinu, the attribute of gevurah. How many tests	No teste, passou cinquenta e sete anos de cegueira, Yitzchak Avinu, a virtude da guevurá. Quantas provas
